scope: Finished owned allocations only; pending/live work is excluded until its terminal receipt is retained
phase_note: Profiling includes the accepted-request span and native grace. Warmup includes harness startup. Post-request harness time includes native drain/export until process exit; those activities are not separately timed. Matching follower attempts use their leader timing, verified by native gang attempt IDs. Unsplit failures and numerical/component screens retain their full allocation cost. CPU builds each requested eight CPUs for 98, 77, 99 and 78 allocated seconds, respectively, and zero GPUs.
